items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh it was just that one night cause I had just gotten fired from J.J.’s band cause we had a little argument in Philadelphia.

ctx.x: You see, we have Donald Bailey and Pete LaRoca and the evening concerts with Wilbur Ware. And there was no explanation as to why, but now you’ve filled in all the gaps about that. (Laughs) So was it one night or two nights?

Oh it was just that one night cause I had just gotten fired from J.J.’s band cause we had a little argument in Philadelphia. I said, “Well I better get away from here cause I don’t want to get excited.” Cause I used to carry a pistol all the time and I said, “Shit I don’t want to be bothered with this motherfucker.” (Laughs)
Who had the pistol? You or J.J?
